questions.question: What exactly does 'linear energy density of up to 2.83 J/mm' mean in terms of the specific SLM process parameters used?

questions.question: Which specific element in the NbMoTaW system exhibited the negative deviation, and why does it differ from the others?

evidence_spans: serving in high-temperature (≤ 1100 °C) environments. However, for super high temperature conditions of up to 1500 °C and 3000 °C
